author: PipiCOC
name: NPC Portrayal
description: People you can picture. The Keeper gives a person's state and a few words of what they do; the sole author turns it into concrete behavior, spending detail where the moment's attention is: the person the moment is about drawn so you can see them, people who do not matter right now in a line. Behavior never changes what the rules settled, and nothing a person hides shows unless your investigator saw through it.
